problems.reason: Both sentences state that the holotype indicates a body length of 2.5 to 3 meters.
The article claims Tarascosaurus measured 2.5–3 m (sentence 1) but also 7–9 m (sentence 2).
Sentence 1 cites an undamaged femur length of 35 cm, whereas sentence 8 states the holotype femur is only 22 cm long.
Sentence 15 declares the species a nomen dubium due to lack of diagnostic traits, while sentence 16 reports recent phylogenetic analyses supporting its placement in Abelisauridae.
